errors.error_description: Introduced multiple continuous drivers on the mem_wen net by assigning it in two separate assign statements, creating potential bus contention.
Used logical AND (&&) between two multi-bit vectors when bitwise AND (&) was intended for mask combination.
In always_comb, assigned addr_hold_next only under a condition without providing a default assignment or complete else coverage, inferring a latch.
Placed an extra semicolon after a declaration, creating a null statement that many linters flag as a syntax-structure issue.
